## Aenean Lacinia

_Cum sociis natoque penatibus et magnis dis parturient montes, nascetur
ridiculus mus. Donec ullamcorper nulla non metus auctor fringilla. The target
variable is transformed as follows (where `x` is the raw value):_

$$
\text{target} = \log\left(1 + x\right)
$$

_Vivamus sagittis lacus vel augue laoreet rutrum faucibus dolor auctor. Duis
mollis, est non commodo luctus, nisi erat porttitor ligula, eget lacinia odio
sem nec elit. The transformation compresses the upper tail, which keeps
downstream colour scales legible:_

```{python}
#| label: transform
#| code-summary: "Show the transformation"

comparison = pd.DataFrame({
    "raw_value": raw["value"],
    "log_value": np.log1p(raw["value"]).round(4),
})
comparison.describe().round(2)
```
